newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tung Chung Station consortium to set HK$6 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Tung Chung Station consortium to set HK$6 bln loan.

text.p: A HK$6 billion loan for a property consortium involved in the development of Hong Kong's Mass Transit Railway Corp airport railway Tung Chung Station Package Two site has been launched, bankers said.

HKR International, Hong Leong Holding and Recosia Pte Ltd, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Singapore Ministry of Finance, each own 30 percent of the project. The remaining 10 percent is held by Hong Kong China Ltd.
Shareholders will offer guarantees for the loan in proportion to their equity stake in the project.
The facility has a final maturity of four years. It pays an interest margin of 110 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.

Underwriting fees are 12.5 basis points for arrangers and senior lead managers committing HK$400 million to HK$500 million and 10 basis points for arrangers and lead managers committing HK$300 million to HK$350 million.
Management fees are 57.5 basis points for both levels.
The development, with a total gross floor area of 2.04 million square feet, is estimated to cost about HK$9 billion.
